verdict: ThorData: Choose ThorData when a budget published proxy/scraper pack is the job — not Bright Data enterprise commits by default. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
weaknesses: Quality must be validated in production
Small packs are not monthly SaaS seats
bestFor: Teams that need a low published GB entry for proxy experiments
Buyers comparing budget residential packs against Bright Data commits
Projects that will validate quality before scaling volume
notIdealFor: Enterprises that require ISO 27001-first proxy vendors
Teams that want Actor marketplace compute (Apify)
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors
Free tiers vs enterprise SSO/audit gates
Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose ThorData when a budget published proxy/scraper pack is the job — not Bright Data enterprise commits by default. Compare Bright Data or Oxylabs for enterprise proxy estates; ScraperAPI for managed credits; Apify for Actors.
editorialNotes: IT web-data peers batch. Approved on it-development-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=web-data-collection. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

Proxy + scraper API lines fit web-data-collection — budget peer of Bright Data, not a hosting panel.
Residential/mobile/datacenter plus scraper/SERP/unlocker/browser cover common jobs; less platform depth than Bright Data.
API-first with lighter published SDK/ecosystem depth than Bright Data or Apify.
Limited public enterprise compliance packaging versus Oxylabs ISO 27001.

Published $2/GB entry is the cluster’s sharpest pack floor — validate quality/compliance for production. Affiliate economics excluded.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
